The City Mayor is the Local Chief Executive referred to throughout this charter as the LCE. Several services end at his signature or approval.

feedbackMechanism.howToSendFeedback: Answer the client feedback form and drop it in the box at the Public Assistance and Complaint Desk in the City Hall lobby.
feedbackMechanism.howFeedbackIsProcessed: The person in charge opens the drop box and evaluates each form; feedback needing an answer is forwarded to the office concerned. Complaints may be filed in writing or in person to the City Mayor, by email, or on (052) 732 7988. After evaluation and investigation the Local Chief Executive calls both parties in for consultation and appropriate action.

services.title: Asking the Mayor's Office for medical, burial or financial assistance
services.description: Help from the City Mayor's Office with hospital bills and medicines, a funeral, or other financial need. What you bring depends on which kind of help you are asking for, and the office is explicit that incomplete documents are not accommodated.

requirements.item: For medical assistance: medical prescription and bills, photocopied
For medical assistance: certificate of indigency, original
For burial assistance: death certificate, certified true copy
requirements.whereToSecure: Office of the City Civil Registrar

requirements.item: For burial assistance: certificate of indigency, original, and the funeral contract, photocopied
For financial assistance: letter, original, and certificate of indigency, original

steps.client: Submit the requirements for the kind of assistance you need at the receiving area.
steps.agency: Receives the required documents for pre-assessment, then photocopies the pre-assessed documents.
steps.personResponsible: Administrative Aide IV and job order staff

steps.client: Receive the assistance from the City Mayor's Office.
steps.agency: Releases the medical, burial or financial assistance to the client.
steps.personResponsible: Executive Assistant IV / Administrative Aide IV

notes: Incomplete documents are not accommodated, so bring everything on the list for the kind of assistance you need.
The charter states these times as per client, being served one at a time.
verifyNotes: The charter's requirements table lists three documents against three sources without pairing them to the medical, burial and financial cases. The grouping recorded here is read from the client step, which does pair them, and should be checked.

services.title: Getting a document signed by the Mayor
services.description: How financial documents and communication letters reach the City Mayor for signature and come back out. This covers obligation requests, vouchers, purchase requests and orders, and letters addressed to the Mayor.

requirements.item: For financial transactions: 3 copies of obligation requests
requirements.whereToSecure: Client or the City Budget Office

requirements.item: For financial transactions: 2 copies of vouchers
For financial transactions: 3 copies of purchase requests and 2 copies of purchase orders
requirements.whereToSecure: Client or the General Services Office

requirements.item: For financial transactions: 1 certification on the alternative method of procurement
For a communication letter to be endorsed to the Mayor: the letter, original

steps.client: Submit the documents at the receiving area.
steps.agency: Receives and records the documents in the logbook, forwards them to the Executive Secretary of the Mayor for instructions and signature, then forwards them to the Mayor. Signed and noted financial documents and letters go back for release and endorsement, and noted documents are endorsed to barangays, private agencies and other city offices for action.
steps.personResponsible: Administrative Aides I and IV, Executive Assistant III, and job order and contract of service staff

steps.agency: Releases the financial documents signed by the City Mayor to the client.
steps.personResponsible: Administrative Aide IV / Administrative Aide I

notes: The charter notes that endorsement, and the release of signed documents, may take longer depending on when the Mayor approves them.
Clients are advised to follow up the next working day for documents still pending because of circumstances beyond the office's control.
verifyNotes: The charter runs agency actions 1.1 to 1.5 under a single client step with one processing time of 30 minutes, so they are recorded as one step.
Two of the agency actions carry the note that timing may vary with the Mayor's availability rather than a duration. Those are recorded in the service notes rather than as step durations.

services.title: Booking a city venue for an event
services.description: Reserving the Legazpi Convention Center, the Ibalong Centrum for Recreation, the Ibalong Conference Room, the Gregorian basketball court or Ibalong Park. You get the letter approved first, then pay, then come back to reserve the date.

requirements.item: Letter request addressed to the City Mayor, original

steps.client: Submit the original letter request addressed to the Mayor.
steps.agency: Receives the letter request for scheduling and checks whether the venue is available. If it is, the letter goes to the Mayor for approval; if not, you are told which dates are open. Once approved, you are given a copy of the approved letter to pay against.

steps.client: Pay the rental at the City Treasurer's Office, or at the City Engineer's Office for Ibalong Park.
steps.agency: Receives the payment and issues an official receipt.
steps.personResponsible: City Treasurer's Office and City Engineer's Office cashiers

steps.client: Go back to the City Mayor's Office with the official receipt to reserve the venue.
steps.agency: Acknowledges and keeps a copy of the official receipt and reserves the venue for your event.

notes: Ibalong Park is paid for at the City Engineer's Office; the other venues at the City Treasurer's Office.
verifyNotes: The charter gives the fee as a range of P40,000.00 to P60,000.00 with a separate P350 a day, without saying which venue each applies to. Recorded as printed; the amounts need checking against the PDF before this service is verified.
The charter distinguishes availability checks for the Gregorian Mall from those for the Convention Center, Ibalong Centrum and Ibalong Park, but gives no separate durations. Recorded as one step.

services.title: Requesting a meeting or inviting the Mayor
services.description: Asking for an appointment with the City Mayor, or inviting him to a wedding, a courtesy call or a speaking engagement. You are told by email, phone or text once it is confirmed.

requirements.item: Letter request addressed to the City Mayor, for a meeting, wedding, courtesy call or speaking engagement

steps.client: Submit the letter request at the receiving area.
steps.agency: Receives the letter and forwards it to the Executive Secretary of the Mayor for instructions, then to the Mayor. If he approves and is free on the dates asked for, the event is added to his schedule, and you are told by email, phone call or text message that the meeting, courtesy call or speaking engagement is confirmed.
steps.personResponsible: Executive Assistant III and job order staff

verifyNotes: The charter runs agency actions 1.1 to 1.4 under a single client step with one processing time, so they are recorded as one step.
